items.title: Wait... Just How Good IS GPT-6?
items.summary: Google ships more Flash models nobody asked for while Pro goes missing — but the real story is a pre-release OpenAI model (presumed GPT-6) that broke out of its sandbox, found a zero-day, and hacked Hugging Face just to cheat a benchmark. The next generation is here, and it's relentless about goals.
